jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

President Traction Division

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our ambitious growth, we are hiring a new Global Business Line Manager, for our Traction Products business line, part of our Motion Traction Division. This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Sweden, France, Poland.

This Position reports to: President Traction Division

As Global Business Line Manager, Traction Products, you will hold end-to-end accountability for a uniquely positioned and strategically critical product portfolio spanning Traction Motors, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and DC-DC Converters.

This is a pivotal enterprise leadership role with responsibility for shaping the future of the product business within the division, advancing commercial excellence, and delivering sustainable, profitable growth across global markets.

Reporting directly to the Division President, you will lead a geographically diverse organization and set the strategic direction for the end-to-end Traction Products business line across its four Product Lines: Traction Motors, Energy Storage Solutions (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and Brightloop.

You will steer the full value chain, from the performance and direction of Product Line-owned factories and embedded capabilities such as R&D, Engineering, and Product Management to commercial execution, while accelerating growth, strengthening customer relevance, and building long-term competitive advantage globally.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Own full P&L accountability for the Global Traction Products business line, driving sustainable growth, profitability, and cash performance.

  • Lead the strategic evolution and scaling of a competitive product portfolio across motors, ESS, DC-DC converters, and auxiliary systems, strengthening value propositions and market positioning across target segments.

  • Set clear accountability across Product Lines for factories, product management, and engineering, while ensuring alignment with business line priorities and enterprise objectives.

  • Define and execute global go-to-market strategies that expand market share, reinforce pricing discipline, and deepen customer intimacy across segments and regions.

  • Establish and drive performance targets that promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the organization.

  • Champion high-impact marketing, sales, and customer engagement strategies that elevate market presence and accelerate growth.

  • Strengthen relationships with key customers and OEMs, positioning ABB as the partner of choice for traction and onboard energy solutions.

  • Lead the successful integration of acquired entities into ABB, realizing targeted value creation, synergies, and organizational alignment.

  • Ensure best-in-class operational performance across manufacturing, supply chain, quality, delivery, and HSE, aligned with ABB’s standards and business ambitions.

  • Build and develop high-performing, values-driven teams through coaching, talent development, and robust succession planning.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Proven success leading global business lines or holding significant P&L responsibility within industrial, rail, mobility, or comparable sectors.

  • Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with a demonstrated ability to scale complex product portfolios and translate strategy into measurable business results.

  • Experience leading multi-product, technology-driven businesses with a manufacturing footprint and end-to-end operational accountability.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead a Product Line–driven operating model with distributed ownership, embedded capabilities, and strong enterprise alignment.

  • Strong understanding of customer ecosystems across multiple industries, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and shape competitive positioning.

  • Proven leadership of large, cross-regional organizations, with the ability to align diverse teams around a shared vision and performance agenda.

  • Track record of delivering results in fast-paced environments with complex operational structures, balancing speed, rigor, and execution excellence.

  • Experience in M&A and integration, ideally with direct leadership in integration programs and delivery of targeted value creation.

  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to ABB’s values, ethics, and compliance standards, serving as a role model for principled leadership.

  • Skilled in leading change and transformation, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and organizational resilience.

  • Adept at stakeholder management, with strong communication and influencing skills at executive, board, and cross-functional leadership levels.

  • Passion for people, customers, quality, and technology, with a leadership mindset grounded in impact and long-term value creation.

  • Ability to develop people and lead with clarity, purpose, and consistency.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

Sales Specialist

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. - Work model: {onsite}

  • Sells control system, instrument, and service to customers, focusing on volume, mix, and profitability targets for the assigned divisions. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


Important remark: This position is open for ongoing talent sourcing; while we are not actively hiring for this role at the moment, we welcome applications to build our future talent pipeline.

Your role and responsibilities:

You will be responsible for sales of electrification, low voltage, and control products in the automation and machine manufacturing segment for the Swiss OEM market, ensuring growth in sales volumes and margins. Reporting to the Head of Sales OEM Electrification, you will leverage your expertise to build lasting customer relationships through outstanding service.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive sales by managing existing accounts, acquiring new customers, and collaborating with marketing, technical support, and sales teams to develop sales plans and identify market opportunities.

  • Leverage your knowledge of customers’ applications and ABB solutions to address needs, focusing on digitalization, Industry 4.0, and energy efficiency, ensuring technical and financial accuracy.

  • Partner closely with ABB distribution channels to enhance customer journey and maintain precise customer data within the CRM system (Salesforce).

  • Continuously expand your technical expertise, monitor market trends, and apply diverse sales techniques such as value-based selling to maximize business success.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical sales

  • Strong technical expertise in low voltage products, with a solid understanding of the Swiss industry and automation.

  • Proficiency in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; experience with order development tools (ERP) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, paired with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

  • Technical qualification, preferably a bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Valid Swiss driver’s license and work authorization in Switzerland.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

A Future Opportunity
Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

jobs.title: (Senior) Research Scientist in Software Systems Engineering (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Industrial Software Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, French Fluency Required (80–100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

  • Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Spend approximately 80% of your time on site with customers, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Technical Consulting: Advise customers on electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV) and present solutions tailored to their technical and business requirements.

  • Value Communication: Clearly communicate the benefits of our products, including improved energy efficiency and reduced CO₂ emissions.

  • Relationship Management: Build trust, identify key stakeholders, and strategically position our solutions.

  • Market & Industry Awareness: Monitor trends in the drives and motion industry and contribute innovative ideas.

Your • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical training in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in sales, with strong knowledge of electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV).

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Our mission is to be a trusted expert in automated industrial systems, with a strong focus on reliability, long‑term partnerships, and a deep understanding of our customers’ needs.

jobs.title: Service Technician (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the maintenance team by carrying out daily activities in accordance with agreed maintenance guidelines and procedures. You will contribute your technical skills to increase the overall efficiency of equipment and production lines across our highly automated machinery landscape.

Work model: Onsite

This position supports the Electrification, Smart Buildings, Energy Distribution business in Schaffhausen.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues on equipment within our diverse and highly automated machinery park

  • Performing preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

  • Working closely with production cells as well as collaborating with Production Engineering and external service providers

  • Contributing to and implementing continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment

  • Supporting improvements in Lean Management practices

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, mechatronics technician, polymechanic, production mechanic, electrician, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 10 years of experience diagnosing and repairing production and assembly equipment (mechanical / electrical / pneumatic)

  • NIV13 or NIV15 installation authorization is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it (costs covered by ABB)

  • Engages constructively with coworkers, communicates clearly, maintains high motivation, and organizes work without close supervision

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP

  • Fluent German skills; basic English skills are an advantage

  • Willingness to work in a 3‑shift system with on‑call duty after an intensive onboarding period

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Salary and bonus structure that includes a 13th‑month payment and participation in an employee share program (ESAP)

  • Professional development through targeted training and career advancement opportunities

  • Sustainability and mobility benefits: eco‑bonus for employees who do not commute by car

  • Discounts such as REKA checks, Swibeco benefits, and access to Felfel food vending machines

More About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • At least 10 years of experience diagnosing and repairing production and assembly equipment (mechanical / electrical / pneumatic)

  • NIV13 or NIV15 installation authorization is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it (costs covered by ABB)

  • Engages constructively with coworkers, communicates clearly, maintains high motivation, and organizes work without close supervision

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP

  • Fluent German skills; basic English skills are an advantage

  • Willingness to work in a 3‑shift system with on‑call duty after an intensive onboarding period

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Salary and bonus structure that includes a 13th‑month payment and participation in an employee share program (ESAP)

  • Sustainability and mobility benefits: eco‑bonus for employees who do not commute by car

  • Discounts such as REKA checks, Swibeco benefits, and access to Felfel food vending machines

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist in Converter-Based Distribution Systems (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems


Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovations at the intersection of power electronic converters and microgrid integration, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on converter operation, intelligent protection coordination, load sharing, and stabilizing control strategies. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems - generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that power ABB's product portfolio.

Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through power converter-based distribution systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to welcome you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Pioneer innovative concepts in power electronic converter-based, low voltage and medium voltage, AC and DC distribution systems.
  • Conduct detailed simulations, algorithm development, and laboratory experiments and publish research findings and patent innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with global, multidisciplinary teams of scientists at ABB Research.
  • Work closely with ABB business units to transition research into real-world applications, including data centers, integration of renewables, industrial electrification, e-mining, and marine systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering with specialization in power electronics, power systems, or control.
  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents.
  • Deep technical expertise in:
    - Power electronic converter topologies, modulation and control concepts
    - Interactions between converters, passive components, and protection devices
    - Microgrid modeling, optimization and stability analysis.
  • Hands-on laboratory skills with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing converter systems and protection schemes. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Service Team Leader


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you will have the opportunity to perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and in compliance with ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure high‑quality customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and carrying them out according to customer orders and expectations. With your clear communication skills, you help maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty by clearly conveying schedules and expectations.

Work model: Onsite

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Key stakeholders include customers, field‑service colleagues, and the internal service coordinator team.

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Collaborating with customers on‑site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Performing field‑service tasks, identifying technical issues, and conducting on‑site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Preparing material lists for service assignments and ensuring that all required materials, parts, and equipment are available and in proper condition

  • Providing training to field‑service colleagues and customers when required

Our Team

You will join a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, electrician, electrical installer, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Extensive knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and field‑service methods in an industrial environment

  • High customer orientation, flexibility in handling changing requirements, and a constructive approach to problem‑solving within the team

  • Fluent German and basic English skills; professional communication in customer interactions

  • Willingness to travel, participate in on‑call duty, and occasionally work on weekends; main service area: Mittelland / Bern region

  • Valid driver’s license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th‑month salary, and employee share acquisition program (ESAP)

  • Development opportunities through targeted training and career advancement

  • Company vehicle and fleet discounts

  • Contribution toward your gym membership and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA checks and Swibeco discounts

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to assist the Quality team in implementing and maintaining a quality system, including conducting audits, establishing controls, training on tools and methodologies. Each day, you will support activities related to quality management within the organizational unit. You will also showcase your skills by reporting quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and customer cases and maintaining process documentation.

Prevention and surveillance have a key role in manufacturing to ensure optimal quality level and keeping cost under control. As production quality technician, you will represent the voice of customer into the shopfloors, ensuring that the control plan and quality procedures are in place and adhered to. You will also monitor CTQ and quality indicator of OEE to take preventive action on quality problems and supervising the release of production batches in accordance with quality prescriptions.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Performing series release tests of manufactured components or products and monitoring the results.
  • Participating in shopfloor meetings within production.
  • Resolving internal claims in cooperation with other departments.
  • Conducting first‑line internal non‑conformity analysis and initiating the problem‑solving process in case of escalation.
  • Managing Q‑data including deployment of quality control procedures in Q‑software and adjustment of process parameters.
  • Controlling and reporting production‑related Q‑KPIs such as internal failure costs, CTQs, and FPY.
  • Providing quality training to production staff, supervising test equipment, and carrying out process audits and confirmations.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Test equipment verification including calibration.
  • Technical background in electrical and/or mechanical fields.
  • Experience performing release tests for serial production.
  • Understanding of Q‑KPIs and control charts.
  • Knowledge of process audits and related quality methods.
  • Good language skills in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Goal‑oriented, problem‑solving mindset with L6S knowledge (yellow/green belt preferred), collaborative approach, initiative, teamwork ability, and responsiveness.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

jobs.title: R&D (Senior) Scientist - Power Electronic Converters (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulating and optimizing power electronic topologies and converters for various applications including conducting broad system level studies.

  • Leading and participating in converter design projects in collaboration with the business while mentoring juniors.

  • Designing, implementing, and testing converter prototypes in the lab.

  • Driving innovation by developing new power electronic concepts and solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD with emphasis on power electronics converter design, optimization, and prototyping. Additional relevant industrial experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on laboratory skills, a willingness to work independently and take initiative in designing, building, and testing converter prototypes. A broader set of skills is expected.

  • Experience with setting-up converter testing by means of circulating power in a back-to-back configuration will be advantageous.

  • Experience in design, commissioning and testing of medium voltage and 3-phase grid connected inverters/rectifiers will be advantageous.

  • Experience in applied control theory including hardware implementation of control for power electronic systems can be advantageous.

  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Internship in Sustainable Polymer Materials (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in August or September 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to current technology development projects focusing on sustainable thermoplastic and thermoset polymers
  • Optimize processing and curing conditions of the materials at laboratory scale
  • Characterize thermal, mechanical and electrical properties, and investigate surface wettability and accelerated aging performance of sustainable polymer materials
  • Perform polymer recycling experiments to enable a circular polymer economy
  • Analyze and document experimental data, present results to the project team, and contribute to technical discussions

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor`s or Master`s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science/Engineering, or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • General understanding of and interest in polymer materials
  • Fundamental knowledge in polymers is of advantage
  • Experience in laboratory work and know-how in experimental methods
  • Motivated, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently
  • Highly conscientious individual with a keen sense of responsibility
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

  • You analyze materials and engineering prototypes using metallographic preparation, optical microscopy and other techniques to obtain a good understanding of the relationship between process parameters, microstructure, and material performance
  • You evaluate the obtained data, document your findings and present them to the team

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • You currently pursue a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science/Engineering or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • You have a general understanding of metals and metal matrix composite materials and the related processing technologies, and you are keen in deepening your knowledge in this field
  • You have experience in specimen preparation by metallography, microstructure analysis by light microscopy and you enjoy laboratory work
  • Experience in powder metallurgy, sintering, brazing, know-how in experimental methods (XRD, SEM, EDX, EBSD, Hardness, etc.) is an advantage

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - Commercial&Operations

__

Your role and responsibilities

Working in the Energy Industries division, based in eastern Europe, optionally worldwide, you will be cooperating with international teams to maintain the highest levels of customer satisfaction in our worldwide applied solutions for electrical power generation. Reporting to the Head of Product Support, you will perform various product and life cycle activities to assist in the development, launch, maintenance, and profitability of UNITROL, MEGATROL and SYNCHROTACT products.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (ideally within presence of current business locations )

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Technical support for ABB experts worldwide, ABB business partners and End customers with Salesforce as the CRM (Customer relationship management) platform and participation in ensuring 24/7 availability of remote support line
  • Leading resolution teams and handling customer communication for support cases where different stakeholders (e.g., System experts, R&D, Quality etc.) build a resolution team according to severity, complexity, and urgency
  • Leading and support with type test activities, component specifications, life cycle solutions and product engineering etc.
  • Supporting customers with grid code compliance studies (e.g. Power Factory, PSS/E, PSCAD) and digital transformation (e.g. cyber security, digital twin). Training and onboarding support can be offered in this matter.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor or master’s in electrical engineering

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in field service or engineering with Power Generation System know how, Embedded Software and Control Hardware plus Power Electronics (Experience with excitation systems is preferred)

  • Specific experience in grid code compliance studies is preferred

  • Fluency in English, any other languages are an asset

  • Proactive attitude to drive innovation and improvement

  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

  • High sense of responsibility and commitment

  • High degree of intercultural awareness

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Senior Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - Commercial&Operations

__

Working in the Energy Industries division, based in eastern Europe, optionally worldwide, you will be cooperating with international teams to maintain the highest levels of customer satisfaction in our worldwide applied solutions for electrical power generation. Reporting to the Head of Product Support, you will perform various product and life cycle activities to assist in the development, launch, maintenance, and profitability of UNITROL, MEGATROL and SYNCHROTACT products.


The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Own product lifecycle management and continuous improvement by leading feasibility studies and managing global product changes (HW/SW/BOM, tools, documentation, etc.). You contribute to cost optimization, standardization, and continuous product enhancement in close collaboration with Product Management and R&D
  • Drive product quality and technical excellence by analyzing and resolving complex issues across a broad product portfolio. You engage directly with customers and perform remote diagnostics, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure sustainable corrective actions to enhance product reliability and performance
  • Act as a global technical authority by providing expert support to ABB teams and business partners worldwide. You support project-specific adaptations, review engineered solutions, and guide standardization decisions aligned with long-term product strategy
  • Strengthen knowledge sharing and team capabilities by capturing learnings from support cases and translating them into structured knowledge documentation. You coach support line specialists and contribute to building strong global lifecycle support expertise

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor or master’s in electrical engineering
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in field service or engineering with Power Generation System know how, Embedded Software and Control Hardware plus Power Electronics (Experience with excitation systems is required)
  • Fluency in English, any other languages like German, French, or Spanish are an asset
  • Intrinsic attitude to drive innovation and improvement
  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • High sense of responsibility and commitment
  • High degree of intercultural awareness

jobs.title: Sales, Service & Project Execution Leader – Critical Power - Switzerland / Austria (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Sales & Service Leader

__

In this role you will lead the Sales, Service and Project Execution organization of ABB’s Critical Power Business Line in Switzerland and Austria. You will be accountable for overall business performance, strategy implementation and challenging growth targets achievement and will be reporting into the Critical Power, Regional, Sales and Service and Project Execution Leader.

Working model: #LI-Hybrid

You’re main responsibilities:

  • Overseeing and implementing the Critical Power business line
  • commercial strategy (sales, tendering, project execution and services) in the relevant countries and evaluating market opportunities and deploying appropriate actions in alignment with Business Line’s objectives.
  • Building and maintaining effective relationships with external stakeholders (e.g. channels, end-users, consultants, suppliers) to ensure commercial success and improve customer satisfaction in the relevant countries. Additionally, working closely with relevant Business Line functions (Project Management, Services, Operations) to support operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensuring pre-sales, tendering, system engineering and product marketing functions are properly staffed and aligned with Business Line requirements across country.
  • Delivering projects on schedule/quality/cost and in alignment with ABB’s project management frameworks as well as managing after-sales support and overall service business in the region in alignment with Business Line objectives.

Your background:

  • Postgraduate degree or above, in Business or Engineering field. MBA preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in UPS industry or Data Center Industry. Furthermore, wide network across data center and semiconductor industry as well as IT channels.
  • Solid influencing skills working across functions, geography, and segments as well as experience in managing large local/regional high-performance organizations and implementing change in a matrix organization.
  • Familiar with tendering, commissioning and project management processes.
  • Previous experience in electric (High, Medium Low Voltage Products and Systems) and automation industry. therefore, familiar with tendering, commissioning and project management processes.
  • Understanding of mission critical segments: Data Center, Semiconductor, Infrastructure, Utility Knowledge of the industry, local governmental requirements, today’s global market conditions, full awareness of the sales function technicalities/methodologies, usage of SAP and other modern day smart tools, and how to use them to serve business and customer requirements.
  • Fluent written and oral communications in English and German as well as willingness to travel 25%

What we offer:

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
  • Generous vacation allowance (typically 27–30 days)
  • Strong emphasis on learning & development
  • Fitness/health programs or partnerships

More about us:

ABB’s Smart Power division is a technology leader in data centers, energy transition and smart industries. Its core product portfolio makes electricity safe and reliable.

Smart Power’s teams create efficient, intelligent solutions that deliver an unbeatable customer experience and help make a zero-carbon future possible.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner, at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Internship in Battery Technology & Prototyping Support (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Energy Storage group of ABB.

At ABB, we envision integration of Energy Storage systems for reliable and sustainable electrical mobility applications as well as for the power grids of the future. To realize this vision, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various battery cell chemistries.

As an intern, you will contribute to advanced research projects in battery technology and advanced manufacturing.

• Your responsibilities will include:

  • Polymer Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing):
  • Operate and support polymer 3D printing processes using state‑of‑the‑art industrial-grade equipment for prototyping and functional components.
  • Development of Battery Test Setups:
  • Assist in the design, development, and assembly of battery test systems. This includes practical work such as designing innovative cell holders, building fixtures, and supporting laser-welding jig development.
  • Testing Operations & Data Analysis:
  • Support test maintenance, launch activities, and experimental campaigns. Collect, process, and analyze test data to contribute to research outcomes.
  • Battery Safety Testing Preparation:
  • Assist in the preparation of battery safety tests, including setup and integration of sensing and measurement equipment.
  • Research Support on Novel Battery Concepts:
  • Contribute to ongoing research activities focused on next-generation battery technologies, including experimental validation and documentation.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Master`s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field
  • Interest in battery energy storage & state of the art technologies
  • Experience with CAD and additive manufacturing is required. Already maturated practical experience in a lab setting and working knowledge of Python is preferred
  • Proficiency in English
  • Willingness to learn and explore new research topics
  • Committed to learning and taking initiative
  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly
  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

jobs.title: Feld Service Techniker:in (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Operations Manager

__

Über die Rolle und deine • Aufgaben

Du bist Experte (m/w/d) für elektrische Anlagen und möchtest Dein Wissen dort einsetzen, wo es wirklich zählt? Als Servicetechniker*in bei ABB installierst und montierst Du hochmoderne Mittel- und Niederspannungsanlagen bei unseren Kund*innen in der ganzen Schweiz. Du sorgst dafür, dass kritische Infrastrukturen zuverlässig funktionieren und trägst wesentlich zur Energiewende bei.

Arbeitsmodell: Field Service

Geschäftsbereich: Electrification, Service, Schweizweit

Einsatzorte: Baden, Morges oder Zuzwil

Deine Hauptaufgaben

  • Installation & Inbetriebnahme: Montage und Installation von Mittel- und Niederspannungsschaltanlagen bei Kund*innen vor Ort
  • Technisches Know-how: Durchführung von Wartungs-, Service- und Reparaturarbeiten an elektrischen Anlagen
  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards bei allen Arbeiten
  • Kund*innenkontakt: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Kund*innen und fachkundige Beratung vor Ort
  • Dokumentation: Erstellung von Serviceberichten und technischer Dokumentation
  • Teamwork: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und Weitergabe Ihres Wissens an Kolleg*innen

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroinstallateur (m/w/d), Elektriker (m/w/d) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Installation von Mittel- und Niederspannungsanlagen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, sowie Kenntnisse in der Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung
  • Führerschein Kategorie B und Bereitschaft zu Einsätzen in der ganzen Schweiz
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Erfahrung im Servicebereich und in der Kundenbetreuung, sowie Teamfähigkeit und professionelle Kommunikation
  • Von Vorteil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ABB-Schaltanlagen, insbesondere mit: Unigear ZS1 (Einzelsammelschiene, Doppelsammelschiene, Duplex Back-to-Back), ZS8.4, Unisec Air, SafeRing SafePlus Air

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Bonus, 13. Monatslohn und Beteiligungsmöglichkeiten (ESAP)
  • Karriereentwicklung durch gezielte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • REKA‑Checks für Freizeit und Reisen
  • Betriebsferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr
  • Verschiedene Vergünstigungen auf Sportausrüstung, Elektronik sowie Gesundheits‑ und Wellnessangebote
  • Beitrag zur Fitnessstudio‑Mitgliedschaft

Mehr über uns

Die Service Division von ABB arbeitet mit unseren Kund*innen zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Vorhersagbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit von elektrischen Produkten und Anlagen zu verbessern. Das umfangreiche Serviceportfolio der Division umfasst Produktpflege, Modernisierung und Beratungsdienste, um die Leistung zu verbessern, die Lebensdauer der Geräte zu verlängern und ein neues Maß an betrieblicher und nachhaltiger Effizienz zu erreichen. Wir helfen unseren Kunden, Ressourcen so lange wie möglich in Gebrauch zu halten, den maximalen Nutzen aus ihnen zu ziehen und Produkte und Materialien am Ende ihrer Nutzungsdauer zurückzugewinnen und zu regenerieren.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Partnerin Mara Werne geleitet.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will have the opportunity to drive high quality life cycle management of critical power equipment: from developing new products and features to maintaining and improving existing solutions. Each day, you will use your skills and technical expertise to generate mechanical design requirements. You will also showcase your expertise by testing and documenting your designs for coordination with other technical teams within AU Critical Power.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power Agile Unit in Quartino, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to the mechanical design deliverables (design and documentation) required for the development of new or enhanced models of critical power equipment.

  • Working with others cross-functionally to deliver designs in a timely manner with high-quality deliverables that meet customer expectations and project requirements.

  • Contributing to design reviews and verification following the established design review process, providing feedback on designs and making modifications

  • Designing and releasing mechanical prototypes, supporting the fabrication of those prototypes, and leading the improvement process following prototype fabrication

  • Leading product design improvement opportunities to reduce product cost

  • Supporting in converting conceptual designs into engineering documentation and in maintaining existing products.

  • Working with all areas of the business (production, supply chain, service, etc.) to ensure products being developed or enhanced meet the needs of the entire business


Our team dynamics:
You will join a diverse and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • A University Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 2+ years of experience

  • Knowledge of solid modeling CAD design software (Creo, etc.) required

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Knowledge sheet metal design, detail part drawings, assembly drawings, and design for manufacturing.

  • Experience in structural simulation and PLM software a plus

  • Experience interpreting and applying electrical safety standards (UL/IEC, etc.) a plus.

  • You are at ease communicating in English



    Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

    Ready to make an impact?

    Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Senior Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

You will join an agile, cross‑functional team of approximately 8–15 employees focused on designing and developing new products.

This role is contributing to the Power Protection/EL/SP/R&D in Switzerland.

The work model for the role is: On Site

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects with limited supervision.

  • Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.

  • Driving the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.

  • Design and develop power converters

  • Specify components and define technical requirements with suppliers

  • Support the overall design cycle of the new product, from simulation to validation and documentation, through design and test

  • Conduct and coordinate complex analyses, develop recommendations based on technology/engineering practices and business considerations

  • Support operations and after sales organization during trouble shooting phases

  • Plan and coordinate a range of complex technology/engineering activities


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with thesis in Power Electronics or Bachelors Degree in Electrical/Electronics and equivalent work experience

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience

  • Experience with power electronic design topologies, knowledge of UPS technology and familiarity with the power protection

  • Mastering simulation tools -MATLAB/Simulink, LT Spice- and programming language -C-

  • Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. Other languages are an asset

  • Significant experience in working within complex organization

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (10%)


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Position 76059728 Production Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Continuous Improvement Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support production process definition to ensure optimization of cost, quality, and on-time delivery of product. Each day, you will participate in the sequence definition, cycle time calculation, and analysis of the working phases of new production processes/products. You will also showcase your knowledge by sharing TPM and cycle time data and improvement ideas with internal teams.

Work model: #LI-Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • TPM (Total Productive Maintenance):

  • Handle tool management activities, including but not limited to maintenance, purchasing, standardization, and ensuring functionality and calibration.

  • Assure production line availability assuring preventative maintenance is adhered to and review data to support improvement interventions.

  • Collaborate with internal customers and external suppliers to meet tool requirements.

  • Project Support:

  • Support Continuous Improvement Specialist with lean projects

  • Training:

  • Develop and implement training documents for TPM, 5S, ESD and other relevant areas.

  • Conduct training sessions for coworkers to enhance their skills and knowledge.

  • Time Keeping:

  • Perform time studies on all prioritized process steps to identify opportunities for improvement and increased efficiency.

  • Ensure the documented times in SAP are correct to actual base line times from your measured time study.

  • Order Processing:

  • Place and confirm orders in “Smart Buy”.

  • Tracking of orders to assure correct and timely arrival.

Your • Qualifications

  • Demonstrated a clear focus on safe work practices with a dedication to following all relevant workplace safety guidelines

  • Demonstrated work ethic characterized by motivation, willingness to handle tasks, and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Comfortable in a teaching environment with the ability to effectively communicate information to a group but also to tailor your teaching approach for individualized learning experiences.

  • Good knowledge of current tools used in operations.

  • Experience working with SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Good organization, collaborative and problem-solving skills.

  • Minimum of two years of experience in UPS manufacturing.

  • Yellow Belt certified and English language a plus

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.
